I translate economic research into policies for long-run growth. My policy work is grounded in sustained collaboration with governments and researchers rather than one-off commentary.

## Selected policy work

::: {.pubs}
- [Making Cities Work for Business](https://www.theigc.org/publications/making-cities-work-business){.pub-title}
  [IGC policy toolkit, 2026 · with Victoria Delbridge, Muskan Jain, and Juliana Oliveira-Cunha]{.pub-meta}

  How infrastructure, services, regulation, and labour-market access allow cities to become platforms for firm growth.

- [Smart Meters for Firms in Ethiopia: Evidence from a Randomised Experiment](https://www.theigc.org/publications/smart-meters-firms-ethiopia-evidence-randomised-experiment){.pub-title}
  [IGC policy brief, 2026 · with Eyoual Tamrat Demeke, Aregawi Gebremariam, [Niclas Moneke](https://niclasmoneke.com/), [Sugandha Srivastav](https://www.sugandhasrivastav.com/), Ephrem Andargie Tadesse, and Tewodros Assefa Tesemma]{.pub-meta}

  Baseline evidence and policy lessons from an ongoing trial with 1,583 firms and the Ethiopian Electricity Utility.

- [Power Structures and Energy Reforms in Sub-Saharan Africa](policy/brief-power-structures-ssa.qmd){.pub-title}
  [IGC policy note, 2026]{.pub-meta}

- [Climate and Environment: What We Know and What We Need to Know](https://doi.org/10.31389/lsepress.tlc.n){.pub-title}
  [Chapter in *The London Consensus*, LSE Press, 2025 · with [Robin Burgess](https://www.robinburgess.com/)]{.pub-meta}

  An evidence-led agenda for sustainable growth, climate resilience, innovation, and the research still needed by policymakers.

- [Sustainable Pakistan: Addressing Climate-Driven Demands and Fiscal Challenges for Electricity](https://www.theigc.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Dobermann%20et%20al%20Growth%20brief%20May%202025.pdf){.pub-title}
  [IGC growth brief, 2025 · with Sajid Faiz Malik, [Faraz Hayat](https://farazhayat.com/), and Zuhair Khan]{.pub-meta}

  Why affordability, fiscal sustainability, and renewable energy must be addressed together in Pakistan's power sector.

- [A Framework for Productivity and Export-Led Growth in Pakistan](https://www.theigc.org/publications/framework-productivity-and-export-led-growth-pakistan){.pub-title}
  [Prepared at the request of Pakistan's Planning Commission, 2025 · contributing author]{.pub-meta}

  A cross-sector strategy centred on productive jobs, competitiveness, tax and state-owned-enterprise reform, trade, cities, and skills.

- [Transition-Critical Minerals](https://www.theigc.org/publications/transition-critical-minerals){.pub-title}
  [IGC policy note, 2025 · with Shahrukh Wani and Jonathan Leape]{.pub-meta}

  How mineral-rich countries can build domestic value, diversify supply chains, and manage the environmental costs of extraction.

- [Innovation, Growth, and the Environment](https://www.theigc.org/news/innovation-growth-and-environment){.pub-title}
  [IGC white paper, 2023 · with [Robin Burgess](https://www.robinburgess.com/), Stefano Caria, and Allegra Saggese]{.pub-meta}

  A research and policy framework for raising living standards while protecting the natural environment.
:::

## Government engagement

::: {.engagements}
**Pakistan.** Advice to senior federal decision-makers on electricity tariffs, power purchase agreements, industrial competitiveness, tax proposals, and macroeconomic reform.

**Ethiopia.** National energy policy, diffusion of solar, and utility reforms, including the evidence base for smart-meter deployment.

**Ghana.** Electricity sector losses, outages, and industrial activity, and their effects on firm productivity and agglomeration.

**Jordan.** Water and electricity tariff reforms.

**India.** Policies for climate adaptation and structural transformation.

**Myanmar.** Research and policy support on the National Electrification Plan, energy pricing, infrastructure constraints, and the development of Yangon.
:::
